title: Cage status report
description: Signed by the pair's Sub device (request signing) and posted to /v1/pairs/{pairIdHash}/cage-status for the pairing that holds the Sub's cage. Carries no cage name, place, position, character name or world. A report whose stateAt is older than the stored one leaves the stored state unchanged.

endsAt.description: For caged, when the lock ends; for armed, when the armed cage is dropped; null for a cage locked until opened and for none.
